visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless top with ruffles, sits in a bright restaurant. She uses black chopsticks to eat from a small bowl. Behind her, large windows reveal a dense urban skyline with high-rise buildings under a clear sky. (2) A close-up shot of a dual-sided hot pot boiling on an induction stove. One side contains a dark red spicy broth filled with whole red dried chili peppers and aromatics. The other side is a clear, light-colored herbal broth. The woman dips a piece of thinly sliced beef into the spicy broth. (3) The woman is joined by a young boy in a yellow shirt. They are both smiling and appear to be enjoying the meal. Various plates of food, including salmon sashimi and grilled items, are spread across the wooden table. (4) A series of quick cuts show the buffet area. A chef in a white uniform and black mask uses a meat slicer to cut thin slices of red beef. Trays of fresh seafood like shrimp and clams are displayed on ice. (5) A man with glasses, wearing a black t-shirt, is shown eating a bowl of braised pork rice and scooping ice cream from a Haagen-Dazs freezer. He picks up a deep-fried bun with mango cream topping. (6) The woman stands in the restaurant, holding a plate with two large steamed crabs garnished with lemon. She gestures towards the camera, smiling and pointing, while promotional text appears as a large overlay.
